messages:
Zoe (Marketing): quick ask for launch materials — can runtime run a 10k stratified bench that focuses on tail latency and multilingual failures? want per-slice p50/p90/p99, token-cost, and failure rate. buckets: <32, 32-256, 256-1024, >1024. langs: en, es, zh, ar, other. Run both fp32 (rwd-7b-v1) and q4_0_v2 (rwd-7b-q4_0_v2). reproducible seed requested. target needed by Monday morning.

Ravi (Runtime): ok. couple clarifying q's: 1) do we separate warm/cold (and if so what counts as warm)? 2) do you want production routing mix or uniform per-language slices? 3) concurrency sweep?

Zoe (Marketing): separate warm vs cold please. define warm = header X-Warm:1 or warmup_tokens=3 (either is fine) — include both as metadata. Use production routing proportions but ensure min 1k samples per language so we can compare. include concurrency sweep 4/8/16. seed=1337 for reproducibility.

Mei (Eng): heads-up: >1024 will hit different kernel paths and will skew token-cost. recommend capping extreme sequences at 8192 and emitting prompt-length CDF. also capture kernel_path in traces. if zh failures look concentrated we might try zh warmup=8 for a follow-up.

Zoe (Marketing): ok cap at 8192 and include CDF. we'll consider follow-up zh warmup based on results.

Sam (Ops): scheduling low-priority job on staging 01:15 UTC tomorrow. example run steps i'll use:

```
./run_bench \
  --model rwd-7b-v1 --quant fp32 --samples 10000 --seed 1337 \
  --buckets "<32,32-256,256-1024,>1024" --langs "en,es,zh,ar,other" \
  --warmup_tokens 3 --concurrency 8 --batch 32 --cap 8192 \
  --tag warm_header=X-Warm:1 --min_per_lang 1000

./run_bench --model rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 --quant q4_0 --... (same flags)
```

I'll post job id when queued. :thumbsup:

benchbot: Job created -> jb-20260306-211. ETA ~5h. logs: https://ci/internal/jb-20260306-211/logs

Ravi (Runtime): implementation note: we'll include per-request fields in CSV: req_id, seed, lang, tok_count, warm_flag, latency_ms, token_cost, error, kernel_path. warm_flag will be set if header present or warmup_tokens>0. ok?

Zoe (Marketing): perfect. please upload artifacts to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4823456789/ and ping here when done.

benchbot: jb-20260306-211 finished. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4823456789/. quick first-pass: q4_0_v2 shows lower p50 on <32 tokens but higher p99 on >1024; overall failure rate 0.29% concentrated on zh long samples. per-slice CSV and raw traces in bucket.

Mei (Eng): saw a few kernel-fallback traces for zh tokenization edgecases — serialized stacks at s3 path above. may warrant a short zh-warmup=8 run to see if failures drop.

Zoe (Marketing): thanks — we'll review CSVs/plots and confirm if we want the zh follow-up. this should be enough for an initial launch bench slide and webinar narrative. :rocket:
